event_definitions.single_animal_separation: deduplicated union of isolated rows, sustained non-origin rows, and size-1 within-group split components
event_definitions.isolated: social_context == isolated, excluding rows inside sustained non-origin dynamic segments
event_definitions.disperser: dynamic_assignment == sustained_non_origin_association; event size is one focal animal
event_definitions.within_group_split: a dynamic social unit appears in more than one temp_group_id at the same timestamp
event_definitions.group_merge_scales: mixed temp-group pairs split into small/medium/large by observed representation fractions
